reason: The peak positions strongly support an approximately 8.005 A pseudocubic perovskite metric, the reduced P4/mmm cell/Z, and a columnar V/Mo average framework, and the submitted geometry is chemically plausible. However, the comparable whole-pattern report contains no score, while the trajectory validated only nearest calculated peak positions and qualitative stick intensities. It fixed an ideal untilted model with the variable equatorial-oxygen coordinate at exactly 0.25, giving identical V-O and Mo-O distances, without a whole-profile refinement of coordinates, displacement factors, occupancies, or preferred orientation. It also did not instantiate and quantitatively compare the principal distinct V/Mo orderings and symmetry-lowered/breathing or tilt variants; its ordering test generated only the chosen columnar pattern. Thus the cell and framework are much better established than the exact P4/mmm symmetry and submitted coordinates/order realization. A further attempt performing whole-pattern refinement and explicit alternative comparisons could plausibly improve the exact candidate set.
